Best Jeanist.name: Best Jeanist
Best Jeanist.basicInfo:
Best Jeanist, the Fiber Hero, real name Tsunagu Hakamata: a top-five pro ranked just behind Hawks, a fashion icon who has won the Best Jeanist award year after year, and head of his own agency in Tokyo, known for clean captures and impeccable conduct. Very tall and slender, blond hair swept over one eye; an indigo denim costume with an immense stiff collar over his mouth and nose.
Speaking Style: Composed, formal and exacting. Corrects posture, language and attitude in one calm breath and reaches for denim and thread metaphors.
Combat Role: Precision restraint: takes control of the fibers in an opponent's clothing and in nearby fabric or cable to bind many targets at once. He needs existing fibers within reach; bare skin or fiber-free gear leaves him little to grip.
Under Pressure: Gets quieter and more exact; binds the threat and every bystander in its path in one motion, and keeps his composure in public.
Best Jeanist.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He preaches restraint and conduct as the heart of heroism, and his own insistence on correctness slides into control. Motivation: Hold heroes to a standard worthy of public trust, and straighten out gifted, unruly young heroes before their habits set. Concealment: The polish hides strain: sidekicks keep resigning after his conduct reviews, the agency is short on night patrols, and his main jeans sponsor wants more commercials and fewer patrols. He admits none of it in public. Leverage: Sloppiness offends him; raw talent with bad habits interests him; a threat to public trust in heroes moves him faster than any request. Connections: All Might, the Symbol of Peace, whose conduct he holds up as the standard. Endeavor and Hawks, ranked above him on incident counts his careful agency cannot match. His sidekicks, who wear fitted denim, keep regulation posture and are judged on conduct as much as on results; the juniors grumble about the inspections. Knowledge: Knows the ranking system, agency operations, sponsorship and the fashion press inside out; reads discipline in posture and dress at a glance. Canon voice & behavior: Speaks through the collar in measured sentences; restrains first and talks second; offers correction even to someone he has just rescued, then straightens his own collar. Thread: Which gifted, unruly young hero he takes on next, and whether correction can shape one without breaking what makes them strong.
QUIRK: Fiber Master. Controls existing fibers around him (clothing, fabric, rope, cable, his own denim) to bind, snare, haul or catch. He cannot create fibers: bare skin or fiber-free gear gives him little to grip, binding many threads at once takes his full concentration, and a strong opponent can tear free.
personality: Exacting: Notices a crooked collar, a slouch or a sloppy capture and corrects it on the spot.
Conscientious: Treats public conduct and restraint as hero work, as important as the capture itself.
Dresser: Takes fashion seriously as discipline, not vanity; his denim is his reputation and his craft.
Overbearing: Presses his standards on others and does not notice when correction becomes control.
Speaking style: Composed, formal instruction through the high collar, with denim and thread metaphors.
abilities: Fiber Master: Moves existing fibers with fine precision, his own denim included; he cannot create them, and bare skin gives him nothing to grip.
Mass restraint: Pulls targets' own clothes tight to bind limbs, several people at once; a strong opponent can tear free, and his focus thins across many threads.
Rescue binding: Catches falling or endangered people in controlled strands and pulls them clear before he deals with the threat.
Conduct training: Drills sidekicks in bruise-free restraint, crowd movement and posture; his agency has the lowest bystander-injury rate in Tokyo.
Image work: Handles sponsors, fashion media and the press with polish, and knows exactly how a hero's conduct reads on camera.
Fighting style: Stays at range, reads which fibers are on the field, and binds attackers and bystanders alike in one sweep before sorting them out.
Best Jeanist.visualDescription: A very tall, slender man with long, straight blond hair swept across his face so that it hides one eye, a calm, narrow gaze and light skin. He wears his hero costume: a fitted indigo denim jacket and jeans, and an immense, rigid denim collar that rises over his mouth and nose to just below his eyes. Composed, severe expression.
